query:
SELECT p.name AS "name!"
            FROM (
                SELECT mc.person_id, COALESCE(mc.order_index, 32767) AS order_key
                FROM movie_cast mc
                WHERE mc.movie_id = $1
                UNION ALL
                SELECT mc.person_id, 32767 AS order_key
                FROM movie_crew mc
                WHERE mc.movie_id = $1
            ) credits
            JOIN persons p ON p.id = credits.person_id
            ORDER BY credits.order_key, p.name
            LIMIT 12
